servicio: Creative Services: dirección de un rodaje de producto para una bebida de retail independiente sin marca visible

preflightVisual.comparacion: J1 conserva lentes de montura plateada, rizos y barba entrecana; J3 da dirección de luz y campo azul; J5 une gesto de trabajo y profundidad. Esta toma cambia el oficio a dirección de rodaje de producto, evita mesa de reunión y blazer navy. Un envase mate azul es la obra en cámara, una pequeña bolsa de arena naranja fija el pie de luz. El estuche de cámara de lona carbón real, cercano al lente y en sombra, forma el lecho desenfocado oscuro para firma blanca.

azul: la botella prototipo mate sin etiqueta, azul activo limpio #0375DB, ~9% del cuadro en el plano medio
acento: bolsa de arena naranja verdadero #F55D01, ~3% del cuadro, estabiliza el pie de luz
vestuario: sobrecamisa de algodón crudo abierta sobre camiseta gris cálido, pantalón carbón; sin blazer ni navy
escena: SCENE (real on-location direction of an unbranded independent beverage product shoot, Mexico City, late afternoon): a single real man, Julio, wears an unbranded open ecru cotton overshirt over a warm-grey T-shirt and charcoal trousers, no suit and no navy garment. From a close low 50mm f/2.8 documentary angle beside the camera kit, he is mid-action adjusting the exact position of ONE matte vivid azure-blue (#0375DB) unlabeled prototype beverage bottle on a clean warm limestone product plinth; the bottle occupies about 9% of the image in this close frame, its front fully visible and physically matte, lit to read as saturated clean bright azure (#0375DB), never dark cobalt or cyan, while remaining smaller than Julio. He looks at the bottle, not into the camera; his face and silver glasses stay clearly visible and in focus. A saturated clean true-orange (#F55D01, never amber, rust or brown) fabric sandbag holding the light stand sits entirely visible in the right midground, close enough to camera to occupy about 3% of the frame; it is the only story accent and visibly part of the actual production setup. A hard shaft of warm-neutral late-afternoon sunlight catches Julio's hand and the bottle while the charcoal camera case nearest the lens remains in even deep shadow, dark enough across its entire bottom-center for a pure-white logo to read at more than 4.5:1. A real camera and one unbranded light stand sit soft in the background; no other people. This is the moment he fine-tunes the hero product light before a take, with a visible work, mechanism and decisive idea, not a generic meeting. No label, writing, brand mark, fake interface or invented logos on any object.

lecho.objeto: the soft woven near edge of a real charcoal canvas camera equipment case lying between the photographer and Julio
lecho.tono: DARK charcoal in even shadow with subtle woven-fabric texture, never a flat black panel
